tasks.subject: Task 1: Part A — store last_chunk_metadata in patch 0002 + harden Dockerfile (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Patched CHUNKED-BATCHES branch stores chunk_metadata on doc_processor.last_chunk_metadata; Dockerfile loop fails build on mis-applied patch.

**Files:** Create docker/docling-graph/tests/test_chunked_batches_stores_chunk_metadata.py; Modify docker/docling-graph/patches/0002-...patch; Modify docker/docling-graph/Dockerfile.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Test applies patch stack to temp repo, drives ExtractionStage._extract_from_docling_document via chunked branch, asserts last_chunk_metadata carries self_refs+pages; fails pre-edit, passes post-edit.
- BARE assignment after extract_chunks_with_metadata, before `if context.trace_data:`.
- Dockerfile loop `patch -p1 --fuzz=0 -i "$p" || exit 1`.
- All 5 patches --fuzz=0 --dry-run clean.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest docker/docling-graph/tests/test_chunked_batches_stores_chunk_metadata.py -v


tasks.subject: Task 2: Part B — prefer per-node evidence_ids in _resolve_element_uid (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** _resolve_element_uid returns per-node evidence_ids[0] (#/ self_ref, precise) over batch-wide self_refs[0] (coarse).

**Files:** Modify docker/docling-graph/app/provenance.py (_resolve_element_uid 205-253); Create docker/docling-graph/tests/test_resolve_element_uid_prefers_evidence.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- evidence_ids[0] #/ self_ref preferred over self_refs[0]; else existing fallback order.
- self_refs=[#/texts/10], evidence_ids=[#/texts/42] -> #/texts/42.
- Direct element_uid wins; self_refs-only still self_refs[0]; chunk_indexes fallback unchanged.
- Existing provenance tests pass.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest docker/docling-graph/tests/test_resolve_element_uid_prefers_evidence.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 3: Part C — resolve #/ self_ref element_uids to precise chunks in worker (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** In derive_structure_links, a #/ self_ref element_uid resolves to its SPECIFIC chunk(s) via identity_map, not all-chunks fan-out.

**Files:** Modify app/workers/pipeline.py (derive_structure_links ~9253/9323-9334); Create tests/unit/test_extracted_from_self_ref_resolution.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Helper _resolve_mention_chunks(...) -> (chunk_ids,is_coarse): direct; #/ via identity_map; last-resort all-chunks(True).
- Unit test: precise single chunk; unmapped #/ -> all(True); concrete uid -> single(False).
- derive_structure_links loads identity_map from _enrichments.identity_map ({} on miss); WARNs on coarse.
- Concrete element_uid path unchanged.

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_extracted_from_self_ref_resolution.py -v


tasks.subject: Task 6: Harden verifier + end-to-end PRECISE-lineage gate (USER-ORDERED)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make verify_lineage_e2e.py prove THIS run restored PRECISE, run-attributed lineage; run on fresh SA-2 graph_only on the fully-deployed fix; confirm precise entity->chunk->page on the graph-query endpoint.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user this conversation. MUST NOT be closed by walking around it or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria item is re-validated independently with output captured.

**Files:** Modify scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Deploy precondition captured: docling-graph rebuilt (Tasks 1+2) + recreated; worker-1 AND worker-graph-1 restarted (Task 3); StartedAt advanced on all 3; live container has last_chunk_metadata=chunk_metadata + reordered evidence_ids check; gemma4 idle; persisted _enrichments.identity_map non-empty (else abort).
- #1 run-scoped: EXTRACTED_FROM WHERE pipeline_run_id=:run count>0 hard PASS.
- #2 drop entity-count-delta false-FAIL; keep absolute recall sanity.
- #3 per-entity precision run-scoped MAX target chunks <=5 (not median/percent); report distribution.
- #4 trace EXTRACTED_FROM-only; warnings from Postgres run window not --since 3h.
- Fresh SA-2: run-scoped EXTRACTED_FROM>0, 0 provenance-drop warnings, element_uid>0, precision MAX<=5, /v1/graph/query SNR-75 sources precise.
- ALL CHECKS PASS.

**Verify:** python3 scripts/verify_lineage_e2e.py --run <run_id> → ALL CHECKS PASS
